images.prompt: Use case: compositing. Create a landscape campaign photograph for a THREE-PANEL SPLIT POSTER. Image 1 is a room and lighting reference. Image 2 is the exact real catalogue artwork and three-panel format to feature. Use Image 1's warm charcoal wall, walnut sideboard, warm sunlight, subtle orange chair and refined interior mood, but replace ALL existing posters with ONE continuous panoramic McLaren Senna GTR blue racing-car artwork taken from Image 2, divided across EXACTLY THREE equal tall rectangular matte paper panels. The three equal panels are hung in one straight level row on the RIGHT 55 percent of the image, small even charcoal-wall gaps between them. The blue racing car must line up seamlessly across all three panels, keeping the actual side-view car, blue livery, lettering, original layout, colours and photographic details from Image 2. Exclude its surrounding beige mockup room and computer. Prints are unframed, trimmed edge-to-edge, no white borders, with tiny realistic paper edge shadows. Keep the entire triptych visible and give it plenty of breathing room at top and right. LEFT 43 percent is entirely quiet dark warm charcoal negative space for HTML headline. A clean premium architectural editorial photograph, straight-on view, realistic wood and paper textures. No other posters, no anime or musician prints, no new advertising text, no UI, no watermark. One polished wide landscape hero background, approximately 16:9.
